items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: Ricard played, I think I did, but I can't recall too clearly. I think I did at one time.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with Ricard and some of the songs?
Ricard played, I think I did, but I can't recall too clearly. I think I did at one time. It seems like he was playing bass, but maybe not. He might have been playing trumpet.
Well I know there are two cornets on its jam up, you know, Celestan and one other. And I didn't know.
